Xi’s speech: impersonal, collective, structural forces, science of history, “Thucydides Trap”

The American conservative and the Chinese communist speak different languages in more ways than one.

So you're saying Brooklyn was hipster before it was cool?


Brendan (@thelifeofB)

Curious where you were living in 2010, because all of that distinction you describe was embedded much earlier in Brooklyn by 2003-2004.



— https://nitter.net/thelifeofB/status/2054983757677904095#m

2000s were blonde tips, last gasp of rock, popped collars on double polos, and Abercrombie & Fitch—totally different aesthetic


Rick Derris (@JaelandoTweets)

Hipsters, Skinny Jeans, tattoos, cynicism, etc... we had all of these things in abundance already.  To note that we simply saw an uptick in all of these things does not define a decade.



— https://nitter.net/JaelandoTweets/status/2054978226590535789#m

2010s seem distinct to me: peak hipster; skinny jeans; tattoo explosion; cynicism, nihilism, irony; vocal fry; blasé folk and electronica (inaugurated by Fleet Foxes, MGMT, etc.); effeminacy heading toward androgyny (e.g., pajama boy)


Matt Walsh (@MattWalshBlog)
